title: Finite-Time Guarantees for Constrained Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
abstract: arXiv:2610.21548v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study reinforcement learning in constrained partially observable Markov decision processes (CPOMDPs), where an agent maximizes reward subject to a cost constraint using only incomplete information about the underlying state. The lack of state observability may require optimal policies to depend on arbitrarily long observation-action histories, making planning and learning challenging. We leverage recent advances in finite-memory approximations of POMDPs and represent finite history windows as states of a constrained MDP. We then develop a primal--dual algorithm that provides the first non-asymptotic guarantees that jointly bound average reward suboptimality and constraint violation in the original CPOMDP. A key challenge is that this finite-window approximation affects both reward values and the set of feasible policies. Under a filter-stability assumption, we derive bounds relating optimality and feasibility in the finite-state model

translated_title: 部分可观测性下约束强化学习的有限时间保证
translated_abstract: 我们研究约束部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（CPOMDP）中的强化学习问题，其中智能体在满足成本约束的条件下最大化奖励，且只能利用关于底层状态的不完整信息。状态可观测性的缺失可能要求最优策略依赖于任意长的观测-动作历史，这使得规划与学习变得极具挑战性。我们利用POMDP有限记忆近似方面的最新进展，将有限历史窗口表示为约束MDP的状态。随后，我们开发了一种原始-对偶算法，首次提供了非渐近保证，能够同时限定原始CPOMDP中的平均奖励次优性和约束违反。一个关键挑战在于这种有限窗口近似会同时影响奖励值和可行策略集合。在滤波器稳定性假设下，我们推导出了有限状态模型中关联最优性与可行性的界。
tldr: 本文首次为部分可观测约束马尔可夫决策过程（CPOMDP）中的强化学习提供了非渐近保证，通过将有限历史窗口表示为约束MDP的状态并开发原始-对偶算法，同时限定了原始问题中的平均奖励次优性与约束违反。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first non-asymptotic guarantees for reinforcement learning in constrained POMDPs, representing finite history windows as constrained MDP states and developing a primal-dual algorithm that jointly bounds average reward suboptimality and constraint violation in the original CPOMDP.
